svg.title: IconPlus
svg.desc: Icon geometry, traced from the locked mockups' inline SVG. The mockups draw every glyph as a 24x24 stroked path (stroke-linecap/linejoin round, ~2px), and the app previously substituted Unicode/emoji characters — which rendered as color emoji injecting off-palette hues (the toolbar padlock sampled #f6cd6a, the edit pencil #ff822d) and, where the shipped fonts lacked the glyph, as literal tofu boxes. The `d` strings below are copied from the mockups verbatim where the source was a <path>. Where the source used <rect>/<circle> (which StreamGeometry cannot express), the equivalent path is written out here and noted per icon. Paths stay in the original 24-unit coordinate space; the `Path.ico` style in Styles.axaml maps that shared 24-box onto the 12/13/14/18px icon box the way an <svg viewBox> does, so every glyph is scaled by the same factor rather than by its own bounds. landing.html: "+" leading glyph on the Create actions
